<div class="card-body">
'''Quad Laser Cannon''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">四連レーザー・キャノン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">２フォース消費して、コレリアン・コルベットかミレニアム・ファルコンに配備する。１フォース消費して起動する。運命数を引くこと。大型艦の場合、運命数＞装甲値で命中。宇宙戦闘機の場合、運命数＋１＞回避値で命中。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-159o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">宇宙船用ブラスター。軽量ですばやく目標を捕捉可能なため、銃座部分に換装されることが多い。ミレニアム・ファルコン等、多数の宇宙船に装備されている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Quad Laser Cannon.

'''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on a Corellian Corvette or Millennium Falcon. Use 1 Force to fire and draw destiny. A capital ship is hit if destiny exceeds armor. A starfighter is hit if destiny +1 exceeds maneuver.

'''Lore:''' A starship blaster. Its light weight and rapid target acquisition make it a common replacement for turret guns. Many ships carry it, including the Millennium Falcon.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Quad Laser Cannon]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
